name: Ed Sanner / Sanner Electronics
notes: Ed Sanner's 1990s FuzzRite reissue is a valuable historical revival node. Effects Database records two batches of 150 units each and a physical enclosure change between batches. Preserve Sanner as designer/builder rather than treating the reissue as an original Mosrite production run.

name: Replica Industries
notes: Effects Database documents a Replica Industries Fuzzrite in the Mosrite Fuzzrite related tree. Manufacturing identity and production period remain unresolved; retain as a separate candidate until corroborated.

name: Theremaniacs / Chuck Collins
notes: Chuck Collins in Big Bend, Wisconsin documented a close reproduction of the Interfax Harmonic Percolator and publicly described the provenance of his reproduction work. Preserve the Theremaniacs and Chuck Collins relationship as one builder lineage, not two unrelated entities.

name: Toneman
notes: Effects Database documents a hand-built Rangemaster reproduction attributed to Toneman and identifies Johnny Dallas as the original mid-1960s unit builder. Geography and complete Toneman catalog need later verification.

name: Pigeon FX
dirt_evidence: Rangemaster; Fuzz Face; Tone Bender; Colorsound-derived products
notes: Pigeon FX's own site documents handmade vintage-family pedals and currently lists a Rangemaster Treble Booster. Effects Database places the Rangemaster in the Dallas family tree and identifies Pigeon FX as a handmade English maker.

name: EdsFx
notes: Effects Database indexes an EdsFx Germanium Treble Boost under the Dallas Rangemaster family. Builder identity, geography and production chronology remain unresolved.

name: Stephen Douglas Design
notes: Effects Database identifies Stephen Douglas Design's Green Shadow as a Buzzaround-based product. A later collaboration relationship with Mojo Hand FX is also documented elsewhere in the family tree; preserve the maker as a distinct lineage node until catalog reconciliation.
